answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the atlas of free entry disappears, the falcon of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the quartz case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm stops being.
